fr-chamonix.note: Steep, technical mountain trails with big views. More enduro than flow. Lifts at Brévent, Flégère and Les Houches.

fr-les-houches.note: A small bike area above the village with a few downhill and flow trails. An easy way to try it with family.

fr-megeve.note: Smooth forest tracks and e-bike loops, with some lift help from Rochebrune and Mont d'Arbois.

fr-saint-gervais.note: Lift-served trails above the village and a long valley of cross-country routes.

fr-combloux.note: Quiet trails and e-bike loops. No bike park or lifts.

fr-les-contamines.note: A small lift-served area and wild enduro trails in the Montjoie valley.

fr-morzine.note: Portes du Soleil: hundreds of km of trails linked by lifts, from kids' tracks to World Cup downhill.

fr-avoriaz.note: A bike village at the heart of Portes du Soleil, with a big freeride park and flow trails.

fr-les-gets.note: A long-running World Cup venue with a full bike park and gentler trails for families.

fr-chatel.note: Border village on the Portes du Soleil lifts, with its own flow and downhill tracks.

fr-la-chapelle.note: Quiet Abondance valley with trails and a link into Portes du Soleil.

fr-flaine.note: Grand Massif bike park above Flaine, with long downhills and a kids' area.

fr-samoens.note: Valley base for the Grand Massif bike park, with a lively bike scene in town.

fr-les-carroz.note: Lifts straight into Grand Massif trails. Family friendly.

fr-morillon.note: Gentle Grand Massif trails reached by gondola from the village.

fr-sixt.note: Wild valley with quiet cross-country and e-bike routes. No lifts.

fr-la-clusaz.note: Aravis bike park with steep forest tracks, strong on enduro and e-bike routes.

fr-grand-bornand.note: Family-friendly village with a good bike park and chalet trails.

fr-les-brasses.note: A small bike area near Geneva. Good for a day, not a week.

fr-semnoz.note: Annecy's local hill: cross-country and enduro trails, no lifts.

fr-les-saisies.note: A gentle bike area on rolling alpine pasture.

fr-crest-voland.note: Calm cross-country and e-bike country in the Espace Diamant.

fr-praz-sur-arly.note: Quiet valley riding and e-bike loops.

fr-areches.note: Quiet Beaufortain riding, mostly e-bike and cross-country.

fr-monts-jura.note: Rolling Jura hills, better for cross-country than lift-served riding.

fr-les-rousses.note: Jura plateau with a small bike park and long easy routes.

fr-la-feclaz.note: Plateau above Chambéry with quiet cross-country and e-bike routes.

fr-aillons.note: A small hill with cross-country trails.

fr-la-plagne.note: Paradiski bike park with a wide range from flow to steep, shared with Les Arcs.

fr-les-arcs.note: Paradiski bike park with long descents and a big kids' area.

fr-peisey.note: Quiet, forested Vanoise riding linked to the Les Arcs lifts.

fr-montchavin.note: La Plagne's quiet side, with a small bike area.

fr-champagny.note: Peaceful Vanoise valley for cross-country and e-bike routes.

fr-val-disere.note: Big mountain riding and famous road passes. The trail network is bigger than the bike park.

fr-tignes.note: High lake area with a small bike park and big-mountain trails.

fr-courchevel.note: A few lift-served trails. Better known for road cycling.

fr-meribel.note: Three Valleys bike park with long runs and family trails.

fr-val-thorens.note: High resort with limited bike trails. More for road climbers.

fr-les-menuires.note: A small bike area and quiet cross-country routes.

fr-valmorel.note: A well-liked family bike park in a friendly village.

fr-la-rosiere.note: A small bike area with views over to Italy.

fr-valloire.note: Bike park below the Galibier, with downhill, flow and cross-country.

fr-valmeinier.note: A small bike area linked to Valloire.

fr-la-toussuire.note: Les Sybelles bike area, mostly cross-country and easy flow.

fr-le-corbier.note: Les Sybelles bike area, mostly cross-country and easy flow.

fr-aussois.note: Quiet Haute Maurienne riding and nearby rock climbing.

fr-la-norma.note: A small bike park in a purpose-built resort.

fr-val-cenis.note: A wide bike area with long summer lifts and high cross-country.

fr-alpe-dhuez.note: Legendary climb, plus a big bike park and high trails.

fr-vaujany.note: Lifts to the Alpe d'Huez bike area, with a calm village feel.

fr-les-2-alpes.note: One of the biggest bike parks in the Alps, with glacier-side riding.

fr-chamrousse.note: A bike park near Grenoble, good for a short trip.

fr-sept-laux.note: A small bike area with views of the Belledonne range.

fr-villard-de-lans.note: Vercors plateau with a good bike park and gentle terrain.

fr-serre-chevalier.note: A big bike park in the Hautes-Alpes, with sun and long descents.

fr-montgenevre.note: Summer lifts on the Via Lattea, with flow and cross-country trails.

fr-puy-saint-vincent.note: A small bike area under the Écrins.

fr-vars.note: Bike area shared with Risoul, with wide open slopes.

fr-risoul.note: Bike area shared with Vars, with easy flow trails.

fr-les-orres.note: A sunny bike park with a famous cross-country scene.

ch-champery.note: Swiss gateway to Portes du Soleil, with the famous Swiss Wall.

ch-morgins.note: Portes du Soleil village with its own trails and a family bike park.

ch-les-crosets.note: High point of the Swiss Portes du Soleil, with easy access to many trails.

ch-champoussin.note: Quiet Portes du Soleil start point with families in mind.

ch-torgon.note: A small bike area at the edge of the Portes du Soleil.

ch-villars.note: Bike park and lots of cross-country across the Vaud Alps.

ch-leysin.note: A smaller bike park above the lake.

ch-les-diablerets.note: Mountain riding and glacier views, with a modest bike park.

ch-verbier.note: Bike park, endless enduro tracks and big mountain views. Classic Swiss riding.

ch-nendaz.note: A big, well-organised bike park with Four Valleys access.

ch-veysonnaz.note: A quiet Four Valleys village with lifts to trails.

ch-thyon.note: High base on the Four Valleys lifts.

ch-la-tzoumaz.note: A small riding area above the Rhône valley.

ch-crans-montana.note: Bike park, long trails and golf-resort comfort.

ch-anzere.note: A small lift-served area with quiet trails.

ch-grimentz.note: Val d'Anniviers: big views and long, wild trails.

ch-ovronnaz.note: Quiet Valais village for cross-country and e-bike.

ch-leukerbad.note: Tough mountain trails above the Rhône valley, with thermal baths to follow.

ch-saas-fee.note: Famous mountain scenery and high riding. Not a big bike park.

ch-zermatt.note: Big mountains and a car-free village. Riding is high and rugged, with a short season.

ch-bettmeralp.note: Car-free village with e-bike and walking routes.

ch-gstaad.note: Smooth Bernese Oberland riding, with a family bike park.

ch-adelboden.note: A friendly valley with a bike park and quiet routes.

ch-wengen.note: Car-free village with railway and cable-car rides. Bike trails are limited.

ch-grindelwald.note: Dramatic Eiger riding with long, scenic descents.

ch-murren.note: Car-free cliff village with big-mountain riding. Limited trails.

ch-zinal.note: Val d'Anniviers: big views and long, wild trails.

ch-riederalp.note: Car-free village with e-bike and walking routes.

it-courmayeur.note: Mont Blanc riding with big views. Lifts open some trails.

it-la-thuile.note: Quiet Aosta Valley village with a bike park and routes toward the Petit Saint-Bernard.

it-pila.note: Reached by gondola from Aosta. One of the better Aosta Valley bike parks.

it-cervinia.note: High riding under the Matterhorn. Short season.

it-valtournenche.note: Matterhorn valley with a modest lift-served bike area.

it-champoluc.note: Monte Rosa valley with a small bike park.

it-gressoney.note: Walser valley with quiet cross-country and e-bike routes.

it-alagna.note: Rugged Monte Rosa trails, with a long climb to start.

it-sestriere.note: Via Lattea bike area with high flow trails and a big range.

it-sauze-d-oulx.note: A well-known bike park with long runs and an easy-going village.

it-sansicario.note: Via Lattea bike area linked to Sestriere.

it-claviere.note: Via Lattea bike area on the French border.

it-bardonecchia.note: Bike park from Jafferau with a big range and an Alpine feel.

it-livigno.note: Mottolino bike park: one of Italy's best, with a big range and duty-free shopping.

it-bormio.note: Cross-country and enduro in the Stelvio park. Road cyclists love the passes.

it-santa-caterina.note: Quiet Valfurva riding below the Gavia pass.

it-madesimo.note: A small bike park near the Spluga pass.

at-st-anton.note: A big range of cross-country and downhill, with lift help.

at-lech.note: Cross-country and e-bike routes around the Arlberg.

at-ischgl.note: Wide high-Alpine riding with bike lifts and lots of cross-country.

at-soelden.note: Bike Republic Sölden: a big downhill park, glacier-edge riding and a strong enduro scene.

at-obergurgl.note: High mountain riding in the Ötztal. Limited lifts.

at-mayrhofen.note: Zillertal bike park with a strong young-rider scene.

at-kitzbuehel.note: A big bike area with lifts, plus road and gravel routes.

at-saalbach.note: Saalbach Hinterglemm and Leogang: a world-class lift-served riding area.

at-zell-am-see.note: Lake, valley and mountain riding, with a good bike park at Kaprun and the Schmittenhöhe.

at-bad-gastein.note: Alpine riding with a spa to follow. Lifts open at the Stubnerkogel.

at-obertauern.note: Quiet pass resort for cross-country and e-bike.

at-schladming.note: Planai bike park and Dachstein tracks, with a very big range.

at-serfaus.note: Bike park at Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, with free local transport and family trails.

at-ellmau.note: Wilder Kaiser riding, with a friendly bike park.

at-alpbach.note: Peaceful Tyrol village with cross-country and e-bike trails.

at-hintertux.note: Glacier valley with some lift-served bike trails.

ch-davos.note: Bike park at Jakobshorn plus big Parsenn and Davos valley trails, with lifts for most.

ch-klosters.note: Quiet Prättigau trails and Madrisa, with e-bike loops. Small lift-served riding.

ch-lenzerheide.note: Big bike park with World Cup flow trails from the Rothorn, plus long gentler routes for families.

ch-arosa.note: Lake and forest routes and some lift-served trails. A small area for a day or two.

ch-flims.note: Flims Trails and the Laax bike park, with long lift-served descents and gentle forest tracks.

ch-laax.note: Bike park with flow lines from Crap Sogn Gion and links to the wider Flims trails.

ch-st-moritz.note: Engadin lakeside riding, the Corviglia flow trail and big alpine routes by e-bike.

ch-scuol.note: Motta Naluns bike park, with flow lines and a kids' area, in the sunny Lower Engadine.

ch-savognin.note: Quiet valley with a small lift-served bike area and easy rolling routes.

it-cortina.note: Cortina bike park on the Mietres and Faloria side, plus long Dolomite road and trail rides. Lifts open some trails.

it-ortisei.note: Val Gardena lifts carry bikes to Seceda and Alpe di Siusi, with scenic trails and e-bike routes.

it-selva.note: Val Gardena bike lifts and the Sella Ronda by bike. Rocky Dolomite trails with big views.

it-corvara.note: Alta Badia has bike lifts and a mix of flow and enduro trails, with the Sella passes on the doorstep.

it-la-villa.note: Gentle Alta Badia trails and e-bike loops, with lifts nearby. More for touring than for a bike park.

it-arabba.note: Steep trails from Porta Vescovo, with the Pordoi and Fedaia passes close by.

it-canazei.note: Val di Fassa bike park at Belvedere and Col Rodella, with Pordoi pass rides close by.

it-alpe-di-siusi.note: Wide high meadow with gentle roads and e-bike loops. Closed to cars in the day, so quiet to ride.

it-kronplatz.note: Kronplatz is a well-known bike park, with long flow and downhill trails from several gondolas.

it-madonna-di-campiglio.note: Bike park with lift-served flow and downhill trails, in a big Brenta Dolomites setting.

it-cavalese.note: Val di Fiemme has forest tracks, a long valley route and some lift help from the Cermis gondola.

it-san-martino.note: Rocky Pale di San Martino trails and a cable car for bikes. Wild and quiet.

it-sesto.note: Quiet Sexten valley with scenic Tre Cime routes and long valley paths. No bike park.

fr-annecy.note: Lake town with road and trail riding all around, bikes for hire on every corner, and the Semnoz hill close by.

at-innsbruck.note: Alpine city with the Nordkette singletrail, from cable car to the valley. Easy city life between rides.

towns.name: Finale Ligure
towns.character: Seaside town and the home of Italian enduro. Rocky trails run from the hills down to the beach, and shuttle vans take you up.
towns.transfer: Shared transfer or car. About 2h30 from Turin or Milan. Train to Finale Ligure Marina.

bike.note: Enduro heartland. Shuttle vans take you up to long rocky trails that finish by the sea. Best in spring and autumn. Hot in July and August, so ride early.

towns.name: Riva del Garda
towns.character: Lake town under steep cliffs and a big name in mountain biking. Trails start from the edge of town, with shuttles and lifts for the long ones.
towns.transfer: Shared transfer or car. About 1h45 from Bergamo, 2h30 from Milan. Bus to Trento for trains.

bike.note: A mountain biking capital. Rocky lake-side trails, long climbs and shuttle rides, plus easy lake paths for families. Hot in summer, so ride early.

towns.name: Locarno and Ascona
towns.character: Sunny Italian-Swiss lakeside towns on Lake Maggiore. Forest trails above the lake, a cable car to Cardada, and a mild climate.
towns.transfer: Shared transfer or car. About 2h30 from Zurich, 1h from Milan Malpensa. Direct trains from Zurich through the Gotthard tunnel.

bike.note: Warm, sunny riding around the lake, with trails from the Cardada cable car and long forest routes. Not a lift-served bike park.

towns.name: Leogang
towns.character: Quiet farming village and the home of Bikepark Leogang, a World Cup venue with lifts almost at the door.
towns.transfer: Shared transfer or car. About 1h45 from Salzburg, 1h30 from Munich.

bike.note: Bikepark Leogang: a World Cup downhill venue with the widest range in Austria, from kids' tracks to steep expert lines. Joint pass with Saalbach.
